deploy-bot: Requesting rollout approval: Nimbus Labs -> Dedicated (eu-west-2). Window: 2026-06-03 23:00-00:30 UTC. Serving image pinned to v3.0.0-rc1 (sha: d7f9e2). Canary plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (12m intervals). Fallback: v2.9.4. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/nimbus-dedicated-rollout

ania (eng-release): Quick summary: quantization profile q8-llm applied, batch size cap 8 for canaries, metric hooks wired to canary-gates. Preflight smoke tests in staging passed at 18:20 UTC.

li (sre): SRE checks: p95 target <= 140ms for eu-west-2, error rate <0.6%, 99th-token <= 600ms. Need explicit pre-warm step for KV cache; does runbook include replay or synthetic warmers?

ania (eng-release): Runbook step 3 includes warmup-replay.py — will run 20m before cutover at 22:40 UTC and then a light load verification for 5m. Also adding a short spike test after 50% shift.

marco (pm): Product note: Customer requested a 15-minute readonly banner at 23:55 UTC for the final switch. Also asked that model prompt templates remain unchanged. Please document in release notes.

tess (cs): Confirmed with Nimbus ops; they require KMS key rotation NOT to run within 24h of rollout. Security-bot, can you confirm current rotation schedule?

security-bot: Noted. Current scheduled KMS rotation for tenant-nimbus: 2026-06-03 02:00 UTC (outside window) BUT there is an org-wide rotation job 2026-06-03 23:15 UTC flagged. Recommend pausing org rotation for the deploy window. Marking high risk if not paused.

li (sre): If org rotation runs mid-deploy it could break agent auth during canary. We should pause rotation. Who can pause?

security-bot: I can open a hold ticket against rotation pipeline. Will mark "hold-until: 2026-06-04 02:00 UTC". Also verified TLS profiles and agent cert chain OK for edge-agents.

ania (eng-release): Added to checklist: [x] Staging smoke passed, [x] Release notes drafted, [ ] Pause org KMS rotation, [x] Warmup scheduled 22:40 UTC, [ ] Go/No-go at 22:30 UTC.

marco (pm): Please add a 30-minute rollback decision window after the 50% ramp (so until 00:06 UTC). Nimbus asked for this explicitly.

li (sre): We'll set the auto-rollback gates to include: p95, error rate, 5xx rate, and token-drop anomalies. Auto-rollback target = v2.9.4. deploy-bot who owns the hook?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot will trigger rollback via registered hook. Example command:

```
# rollback example
redwood-deploy rollback --tenant=nimbus --to=v2.9.4 --reason="canary-gate"
```

deploy-bot: Registered canary-gates: p95 <= 140ms, error_rate < 0.6%, 5xx < 0.2%, token_latency_99 < 600ms. If any gate breached for two consecutive checks, rollback will run.

tess (cs): CS confirmed customer will display readonly banner as requested. They'll also accept a 15-minute notification window prior to final step.

security-bot: Hold ticket created for org rotation: ROT-HOLD-993. Recommend audit post-deploy: /audit/run nimbus-2026-06-03. Also note: agent image signature validated against release-key-2026.

ania (eng-release): Final checklist in runbook comments. Key items: [x] Release notes published to customer portal, [x] Staging tests green, [x] KMS hold created (ROT-HOLD-993), [x] Warmup at 22:40 UTC, [ ] Go/No-go at 22:30 UTC.

marco (pm): I'll lead Go/No-go. I'll be present at 22:30 UTC.

li (sre): SRE approves conditionally. I'll be oncall for the window and will escalate if metrics degrade.

tess (cs): CS approves. I'll send final reminder to Nimbus ops at 22:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: When ready, reply with "approve" to lock the window. Reminder ping scheduled at 22:00 UTC to @marco (pm), @tess (cs), @li (sre), @ania (eng-release).

ania (eng-release): approve (locking window).

li (sre): approve.

marco (pm): approve. I'll do go/no-go.

security-bot: approve from security (rotation on hold).

deploy-bot: Window locked. Deploybot will start canary at 23:00 UTC. Links: logs: https://logs.redwood/nimbus/4951234567, runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/nimbus-dedicated-rollout, rollback guide: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/rollback-guides#nimbus

ania (eng-release): I'll post a short release summary to the customer's support channel 30m prior and update the ticket after each canary phase.

li (sre): Watching metrics. Ready to trigger rollback if gates trip.

(deploy-bot automated note): go/no-go reminder sent at 22:00 UTC.
